question: 单项选择：Please wait here _____ I come back. A. until  B. so that  C. because  D. when
用所给词的适当形式填空：He studies hard ______ (so that) he can pass the exam.
answer: 答案：so that。解析：so that"为了"，引导目的状语从句。

question: 单项选择：Don't leave _____ I tell you to. A. until  B. so that  C. because  D. when
翻译句子：直到雨停了我们才回家。
answer: 答案：We didn't go home until the rain stopped. 解析：not...until"直到...才"。the rain stopped是过去时从句。

question: 单项选择：She got up early _____ she could catch the first bus. A. until  B. so that  C. because  D. when
answer: 答案：B. so that。解析：so that引导目的状语从句，"为了能..."。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Please speak slowly ______ (so that) I can understand you.
answer: 答案：so that。解析：so that"为了"。

question: 单项选择：I will wait for you _____ the rain stops. A. until  B. so that  C. because  D. when
answer: 答案：A. until。解析：wait until"等到"。

question: 翻译句子：他努力学习以便能考上一所好大学。
answer: 答案：He studies hard so that he can get into a good university. 解析：so that"以便"。

question: 单项选择：He kept reading _____ midnight. A. until  B. so that  C. because  D. when
answer: 答案：A. until。解析：until midnight"直到午夜"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She woke up ______ (so that/until) she could finish her homework.
answer: 答案：so that。解析：so that"为了能"，引导目的状语从句。
